scope: FieldLog section 21.2 Debug iOS local synthetic account deletion

patch.verification: Verified strict git apply and reverse with a private index. Each patch reverses independently from the composed tree.

host.transport: The host URLSession adapter remapped the socket to an ephemeral IPv4 loopback listener with the fixed Host and Origin. The shipping Apple adapter compiled for host and iPhoneOS. A private atomic file stood in for the Keychain slot.
observations: Normal confirmed deletion removed the scoped files and credential slot. Staging was durable before the first POST and suspended sync. Missing and mismatched fixture authorizations, stale confirmations, and a refused secure write could not stage deletion.

The server committed the deletion and dropped the reply before writing it. A different listener and independent Swift processes resent the original bearer and byte-identical body. SQLite retained one receipt.

A mismatched positive receipt and a refused receipt write preserved all local files. The durable positive receipt survived interruption after partial removal and a second interruption after directory removal before clearing the slot. Later cleanup ran with no listener.

Parent symlink substitution was rejected. The ordinary workspace, another account, and a sibling project retained their files. A late receipt could not clear a newer account's credential or the retired account's files.

A genuine expired-bearer 401 preserved the scoped files. Fresh peer sign-in could not reauthorize. The original account reauthorized after restart, remained locked until a new confirmation, and then used a fresh bearer and key.

Ordinary sign-in, cold session and revocation records, recovery attempt and session records, sign-in with the replacement code, and TaskSync through the real workspace repository passed. The revoked grant received 401.
The pinned Python backend regression passed ordinary account, recovery, static sync, transactional rollback, scoped deletion, and receipt replay with disposable SQLite.

genericIPhoneOS.command: xcodebuild -project "$app/ios/FieldLog.xcodeproj" -scheme FieldLog -configuration Debug -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath "$build/derived" -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath "$build/packages" -packageCachePath "$build/package-cache" -disableAutomaticPackageResolution -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile -skipPackageUpdates -disablePackageRepositoryCache -scmProvider system -jobs 8 CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB=NO COMPILER_INDEX_STORE_ENABLE=NO "HEADER_SEARCH_PATHS=\$(inherited) $sdk/vm/include" "LIBRARY_SEARCH_PATHS=$build/lib" "CLANG_MODULE_CACHE_PATH=$build/clang-cache" build
genericIPhoneOS.result: BUILD SUCCEEDED. The arm64 app linked with platform IOS, minos 26.0 and SDK 27.2. LC_CODE_SIGNATURE was absent and Info.plist registered com.fieldlog.dev.ios.
genericIPhoneOS.dependencyResolution: Used the pinned local SDK lock and existing Swift Crypto and Swift ASN.1 Git objects. Git permitted file transport only. The app project lock was restored byte-for-byte.

cleanup.fixedPort8765: Bind preflight found the port occupied. The fixture used ephemeral ports.
cleanup.fixtureListeners: Every owned listener joined and its ephemeral port rebound after closure.
cleanup.ownedScratch: Removed the owned checkout, module and build caches, logs, binaries, and disposable SQLite fixtures. Verified the namespace was absent.

remaining: Root owns device or Simulator UI, native Keychain runtime, and Android attachment.
